hypothesis: Fewer whole warps per CTA may reduce small-batch transform latency, especially M17 N256. Changing launch geometry need not improve every shape or beat Dao.

all_elements: fused packed/scales bitwise equality against thread128
each fused equals its same-thread transform then quantize
independent CPU float32 division/RNE INT4 packed/scales for all rows
correctness.scale: 1 or normalized scale rounded once to IEEE float32, then the same value passed to every implementation and CPU oracle
correctness.failure_policy: Abort timing for this process on any numerical/provenance failure; retain JSON context, first mismatch and CPU witness. Do not relax expectation.

graph.outputs: 64 distinct retained allocations per method, disjoint across private graphs; bytewise equality before and after timing

eager.scope: CUDA events around allocating Python API calls, including host-dispatch GPU idle gaps, not pure kernel or CPU wall-clock end-to-end

timing.order: Per-process method order uses deterministic Random(91000+run_index); each group cyclically rotates methods by group+case_index; graph/eager order alternates by case+run index. Config order uses Random(92000+run_index). Record actual order.
timing.samples: Keep every raw event interval in ms and per-call ms/us; median of 5 groups within each process; never combine scopes or use earlier study timings as denominators.

selection.screen_rule: Thread qualifies for holdout only if at least one of 24 screen configurations shows >=5% graph time reduction versus same-run128 in each of 3 valid processes. Keep and report every slow case. All three processes must pass numerical checks.
selection.validation_rule: Run the fixed 120 holdout configurations for all qualified threads and controls128/256/Dao. Combine screen and holdout only as 144 predeclared configurations, preserving stage labels and same-run denominators. No automatic production dispatch is implemented.
selection.no_candidate: Stop after screen with a negative or inconclusive finding; no new search domain or looser threshold.
selection.target_gap: M17 N256 evaluated separately by dtype and scale; gap closed only if candidate median <= Dao median in all 3 processes. Differences <=1% are near-ties, not durable wins.
selection.range_safety: Any proposed dispatch range must list all included cases and every >3% regression against128 in any process. A stable >=5% winner alone does not establish safe dispatch for neighbors or other hardware.

resource_policy: Wait for coordinator GPU window; check jobs/GPU utilization before execution; do not stop unrelated processes. Three workers run sequentially in a dedicated directory/cache. Existing idle resident contexts are recorded, not treated as proof of exclusive tenancy. No dependency upgrades.
claim_limits: Only launch configuration changes. No automatic shape policy, new butterfly arithmetic, quantization contract changes, physical bandwidth claims, or proof of global optimality. Quantization is correctness-only in this experiment.
